next.reason: For nested programs 1985 already selects as 2023 does: §1985:X.5.5.4 GR1 picks 'The declarative within the program that contains the statement which caused the qualifying condition', then GLOBAL declaratives of each containing program up to the outermost, else none. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR4 restates that order ('a qualifying declarative with the GLOBAL attribute in the next inclusive directly containing source element'), §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 selects at most one, §2023:14.9.49.4 GR1 ties invocation to the USE conditions. Neither searches outside the compilation unit.
